name: Aside
summary: AI browser that completes tasks across your logged-in websites and accounts, with a built-in agent password manager.
description: A desktop browser built for both people and AI agents. Aside works across the websites you are signed into to run tasks — messages, payments, internal tools — with local memory built from browsing history, autofill-based sign-in that keeps credentials invisible to the AI, and approval gates for sensitive actions. Free plan plus Pro and Max subscriptions.

memory from browsing history, kept local with Secure Enclave and post-quantum encryption
agent password manager autofills credentials without exposing them to the AI
browser agent, Ultrabrowse deep research, routines, channels remote control, cloud handoff
